questions.stem: A 45-year-old woman presents with palpitations, vomiting, diarrhea and marked agitation following an abrupt discontinuation of her antithyroid medication following a UTI. On examination, she is diaphoretic with proptosis and diffuse neck swelling with prominent jugular pulsations . Vitals are pulse: 120/min, BP 160/100 mm Hg, RR 24/min Temp: 39 C. Which of the following is best drug for managment of this patient?
